  'lookup_key', 'query', 'matched_value',
];

const TEXT_KEYS = ['message_excerpt', 'message_text', 'body', 'content', 'note'];
const REDACTION_MARKERS = ['[redacted]', '<redacted>', 'redacted', '***', '[deleted]'];

function hasDirectIdentifier(row) {
  for (const key of DIRECT_IDENTIFIER_KEYS) {
    if (row[key] !== undefined && row[key] !== null && row[key] !== '' && row[key] !== 'null') return true;
  }
  for (const key of ['profile', 'document']) {
    const nested = row[key];
    if (nested && typeof nested === 'object') {
      for (const sub of DIRECT_IDENTIFIER_KEYS) {
        if (nested[sub] !== undefined && nested[sub] !== null && nested[sub] !== '' && nested[sub] !== 'null') return true;
      }
    }
  }
  return false;
}

function textRedacted(row) {
  for (const key of TEXT_KEYS) {
    const value = row[key];
    if (typeof value === 'string') {
      const lowered = value.trim().toLowerCase();
      if (REDACTION_MARKERS.some((marker) => lowered.includes(marker))) return true;
    }
  }
  return false;
}

function stateOf(row) {
  const status = String(row.account_status || '').toUpperCase();
  if (['DELETED', 'TOMBSTONED'].includes(status)) {
    return hasDirectIdentifier(row) ? 'PRESENT' : 'REDACTED';
  }
  if (textRedacted(row)) return 'REDACTED';
  if (row.result !== undefined) {
    const token = String(row.result || '').toUpperCase();
    if (['HIT', 'FOUND', 'PRESENT'].includes(token)) return 'PRESENT';
    if (['MISS', 'NOT_FOUND', 'ABSENT'].includes(token)) return 'ABSENT';
  }
  if (row.hits && typeof row.hits === 'object') {
    return Number(row.hits.total) === 0 ? 'ABSENT' : 'PRESENT';
  }
  if (row.status_code !== undefined) {
    return String(row.status_code) === '404' ? 'ABSENT' : 'PRESENT';
  }
  if (row.enabled !== undefined) {
    return ['true', '1', 1, true].includes(row.enabled) ? 'ACTIVE' : 'DISABLED';
  }
  if (row.restore_allowed !== undefined) {
    return ['true', '1', 1, true].includes(row.restore_allowed) ? 'ACTIVE' : 'BLOCKED';
  }
  if (row.last_delivery_status !== undefined) {
    const token = String(row.last_delivery_status || '').toLowerCase();
    if (['stopped', 'disabled'].includes(token)) return 'DISABLED';
  }
  return 'PRESENT';
}

function flattenHits(row) {
  if (!row.hits || typeof row.hits !== 'object') return row;
  const docs = Array.isArray(row.hits.documents) ? row.hits.documents : [];
  if (!docs.length || typeof docs[0] !== 'object') return row;
  const merged = { ...docs[0] };
  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(row)) {
    if (key !== 'hits' && merged[key] === undefined) merged[key] = value;
  }
  return merged;
}

function identifiersOf(row) {
  const out = {};
  for (const key of PERSON_KEYS) {
    const value = row[key];
    if (value === null || value === undefined || value === '' || value === 'null') continue;
    if (value && typeof value === 'object' && !Array.isArray(value)) {
      const nested = {};
      for (const [sub, nestedValue] of Object.entries(value)) {
        if (nestedValue !== null && nestedValue !== undefined && nestedValue !== '' && nestedValue !== 'null') {
          nested[sub] = nestedValue;
        }
      }
      if (Object.keys(nested).length) out[key] = nested;
    } else {
      out[key] = value;
    }
  }
  for (const key of ['profile', 'document']) {
    const nested = row[key];
    if (nested && typeof nested === 'object') {
      for (const sub of ['email', 'phone', 'email_hash', 'full_name', 'name', 'display_name', 'customer_reference', 'user_id']) {
        const value = nested[sub];
        if (value !== null && value !== undefined && value !== '' && value !== 'null') {
          out[`${key}.${sub}`] = value;
        }
      }
    }
  }
  return out;
}

function rowRecords(evidence, system, collection, rawRow, capturedAt, collectionIndex = null, rowIndex = null) {
  if (!rawRow || typeof rawRow !== 'object') return [];
  const row = flattenHits(rawRow);
  const resourceId = String(row.resource_id || rawRow.resource_id || '');
  if (!resourceId) return [];
  const resolvedSystem = system || guessSystem(resourceId);
  const explicitType = row.record_type || rawRow.record_type;
  const recordType = guessRecordType(resolvedSystem, collection, explicitType);
  const observedAt = row.observed_at || row.recorded_at || row.updated_at || capturedAt;
  const linkKeys = [];
  for (const key of ['lookup_key', 'query', 'lookup_value', 'subject_selector']) {
    const value = row[key];
    if (typeof value === 'string' && value && value !== 'null') linkKeys.push(value);
  }
  if (row.profile && typeof row.profile === 'object') {
    for (const key of ['customer_reference', 'email', 'phone', 'email_hash']) {
      const value = row.profile[key];
      if (typeof value === 'string' && value && value !== 'null') linkKeys.push(value);
    }
  }
  const record = makeRecord({
    evidenceId: evidence.file_id,
    capturedAt: evidence.captured_at,
    observedAt,
    system: resolvedSystem,
    resourceId,
    recordType,
    state: stateOf(row),
    identifiers: identifiersOf(row),
    linkKeys,
    payload: { ...row, _collection: collection, _captured_at: capturedAt },
    parser: 'json_records',
    sourcePath: evidence.file_path,
    rowIndex,
    collectionIndex,
  });
  return [record];
}

function parse(evidence) {
  const document = readJson(evidence.absolute_path);
  const capturedAt = document.captured_at || document.exported_at || evidence.captured_at;
  const records = [];
  const shapes = [];

  if (Array.isArray(document.snapshots)) {
    shapes.push(`snapshots=${document.snapshots.length}`);
    for (const [snapshotIndex, snapshot] of document.snapshots.entries()) {
      const system = snapshot.data_store || '';
      const collection = snapshot.collection || '';
      const snapshotCaptured = snapshot.captured_at || capturedAt;
      for (const [rowIndex, row] of (snapshot.records || []).entries()) {
        records.push(...rowRecords(evidence, system, collection, row, snapshotCaptured, snapshotIndex, rowIndex));
      }
    }
  }

  if (document.service_exports && typeof document.service_exports === 'object') {
    shapes.push(`services=${Object.keys(document.service_exports).length}`);
    for (const [system, collections] of Object.entries(document.service_exports)) {
      if (!collections || typeof collections !== 'object') continue;
      for (const [collection, rows] of Object.entries(collections)) {
        if (!Array.isArray(rows)) continue;
        for (const [rowIndex, row] of rows.entries()) {
          records.push(...rowRecords(evidence, system, collection, row, document.exported_at || capturedAt, null, rowIndex));
        }
      }
    }
  }

  if (Array.isArray(document.records)) {
    shapes.push(`records=${document.records.length}`);
    const defaultSystem = document.system || '';
    for (const [rowIndex, row] of document.records.entries()) {
      const system = row.system || defaultSystem;
      const collection = row.collection || document.collection || '';
      records.push(...rowRecords(evidence, system, collection, row, capturedAt, null, rowIndex));
    }
  }

  return { records, detail: shapes.length ? shapes.join(' ') : 'unrecognized' };
}

function categoryOfResource(resourceId) {
  return PREFIX_CATEGORY[prefixOf(resourceId)] || 'UNKNOWN';
}

function categoryOfActivity(event) {
  if (event.target_system === 'analytics_platform' && event.event_type === 'DELETE_RECORD') return 'CACHE_ENTRY';
  if (event.target_system === 'support_platform' && event.event_type === 'DELETE_RECORD') return 'SUPPORT_ATTACHMENT';
  return categoryOfResource(event.resource_id);
}

function addOwner(map, resourceId, userId) {
  if (!resourceId || !userId) return;
  if (!map.has(resourceId)) map.set(resourceId, new Set());
  map.get(resourceId).add(userId);
}

function ownersOf(map, resourceId) {
  return map.get(resourceId) || new Set();
}

function isResourceRef(value) {
  const text = String(value || '');
  if (SYSTEM_IDS.has(text)) return false;
  return /^[a-z][a-z0-9]*_[a-z0-9]+$/.test(text) && /\d/.test(text);
}

function hasMultipleEmbeddedSubjects(record) {
  const payload = record.payload || {};
  const ids = Array.isArray(payload.resource_ids) ? payload.resource_ids : [];
  if (new Set(ids.map(String)).size > 1) return true;
  const emails = Array.isArray(payload.emails) ? payload.emails : [];
  if (new Set(emails.map((value) => String(value).toLowerCase())).size > 1) return true;
  return false;
}

function manifestResourceMap(store) {
  const map = new Map();
  for (const record of store.records) {
    if (record.evidenceKind !== 'manifest' || !record.resourceId) continue;
    if (!map.has(record.resourceId)) map.set(record.resourceId, []);
    map.get(record.resourceId).push(record);
  }
  return map;
}

function hasRelevantManifest(manifestByResource, resourceId, request) {
  const records = manifestByResource.get(resourceId) || [];
  for (const record of records) {
    const timestamp = parseTs(record.observedAt || record.capturedAt);
    if (timestamp === null) continue;
    if (request.auditMs !== null && timestamp > request.auditMs) continue;
    if (request.requestedMs !== null && timestamp < request.requestedMs - 90 * 86400000) continue;
    return true;
  }
  return false;

      const distance = Math.abs(event.eventMs - request.reportedMs) / 60000;
      let score = Math.min(distance / 60, 4);
      if (!hint) score += 0.5;
      if (event.reported_result === 'SUCCESS' && request.reported_status === 'COMPLETE') score -= 0.15;

  for (const [fileId, records] of byFile.entries()) {

        candidates.push(request);

      for (let i = 0; i < unlinked.length; i += 1) {
        const request = candidates[i];

        assignments.push({
          case_id: request.case_id,
          user_id: request.user_id,
          resource_id: unlinked[i].resourceId,
          event_id: '',
          reason: 'bundle_position',
          score: 0,
        });
      }
    }
  }
  return assignments;
}

function closeToReported(request, eventMs, before = 240, after = 300) {
  if (!request.reportedMs || !eventMs) return false;
  const minutes = (eventMs - request.reportedMs) / 60000;
  return minutes >= -before && minutes <= after;
}

function resultCompatibility(status, result) {
  const normalized = String(result || '').toUpperCase();
  if (status === 'COMPLETE') {
    if (normalized === 'SUCCESS') return 0;
    if (normalized === 'PARTIAL') return 0.5;
    return 2.5;
  }
  if (status === 'NOT_STARTED') {
    if (normalized === 'FAILED') return 0;
    if (normalized === 'PARTIAL') return 1;
    return 2.5;
  }
  if (normalized === 'FAILED' || normalized === 'PARTIAL') return 0;
  return 0.75;
}

function hasHint(request, category) {
  const pattern = HINTS[category];
  if (!pattern) return false;
  return pattern.test(request.request_text || '');
}

function hasCategoryForUser(resourceUsers, userId, category) {
  for (const [resourceId, users] of resourceUsers.entries()) {
    if (!users.has(userId)) continue;
    if (categoryOfResource(resourceId) === category) return true;
  }
  return false;
}

import path from 'node:path';
import { loadManifest } from './tables.js';
import { ObservationStore } from './model.js';
import { parse as parseJson } from './parsers/json.js';
import { parse as parseLog } from './parsers/log.js';
import { parse as parseSql } from './parsers/sql.js';
import { parse as parseText } from './parsers/text.js';
import { parse as parsePdf } from './parsers/pdf.js';
import { parse as parseImage } from './parsers/image.js';
import { buildActivityRecords } from './activity.js';
import { loadActivity } from './tables.js';

const PARSERS = {
  '.json': parseJson,
  '.log': parseLog,
  '.sql': parseSql,
  '.txt': parseText,
  '.pdf': parsePdf,
  '.png': parseImage,
  '.jpg': parseImage,
  '.jpeg': parseImage,
};

async function parseEvidenceFile(evidence) {
  const parser = PARSERS[evidence.suffix];
  if (!parser) return { records: [], detail: `no-parser suffix=${evidence.suffix}` };
  try {
    return await parser(evidence);
  } catch (error) {
    return { records: [], detail: `error=${error.message.slice(0, 200)}` };
  }
}

async function buildEvidenceStore({ includeManifest = true } = {}) {
  const store = new ObservationStore();
  const manifest = loadManifest();

  if (includeManifest) {
    for (const evidence of manifest) {
      const result = await parseEvidenceFile(evidence);
      for (const record of result.records) store.add(record);
      store.logFile(
        evidence.file_id,
        evidence.file_path,
        path.basename(evidence.absolute_path),
        result.records.length,
        result.detail.startsWith('error=') ? 'error' : 'ok',
        result.detail,
      );
    }
  }

  const activity = loadActivity();
  const activityRecords = buildActivityRecords(activity);
  store.extend(activityRecords);
  store.logFile('system_activity.csv', 'dataset/system_activity.csv', 'activity', activityRecords.length, 'ok', `events=${activity.length}`);

  return { store, manifest, activity };
}

function isRetentionApplicable(record, category, auditMs) {
  if (category === 'SECURITY_AUDIT_LOG') {
    const until = record.payload?.retention_until || record.payload?.retain_until || record.identifiers?.retention_until;
    if (until) {
      const ms = parseTs(until);
      if (ms !== null && auditMs !== null && ms < auditMs) return false;
    }
    return true;
  }
  if (category === 'LEGAL_HOLD_RECORD') {
    const status = String(record.payload?.hold_status || record.payload?.status || '').toLowerCase();
    if (['released', 'inactive', 'expired'].includes(status)) return false;
    const until = record.payload?.hold_until || record.payload?.expires_at;
    if (until) {
      const ms = parseTs(until);
      if (ms !== null && auditMs !== null && ms < auditMs) return false;
    }
    return true;
  }
  return true;
}

const HARD_NEGATIONS = [
  /not asking for deletion/i,
  /not a request to erase/i,
  /not a request to delete/i,
  /do not close the account/i,
  /don'?t close the account/i,
  /do not delete/i,
  /don'?t delete/i,
  /do not remove/i,
  /don'?t remove/i,
  /please don'?t delete or change anything/i,
  /without removing any of my records/i,
  /leave the account active/i,
  /keep the account as it is/i,
  /leave my profile and purchase history in place/i,
  /i still (?:need|use|want) the account/i,
  /i want to continue using the service/i,
  /i still want receipts/i,
  /this is an information request/i,
];

const DELETION_TERMS = [
  /delet/i,
  /eras/i,
  /erasure/i,
  /remov/i,
  /\bgone\b/i,
  /close (?:my|this|the) account/i,
  /clos(?:e|ed|ing) (?:it|my|this|the) account/i,
  /\bclosed\b/i,
  /purge/i,
  /permanently removed?/i,
  /profile is gone/i,
  /nothing .* point back to me/i,
  /elimina/i,
  /eliminaci[oó]n/i,
  /borrar/i,
  /borrado/i,
  /exclus[ãa]o/i,
  /excluir/i,
  /apagar/i,
  /deletar/i,
  /suprimir/i,
  /cerrar (?:mi|la) cuenta/i,
  /suppress?ion/i,
  /supprimer/i,
  /effacer/i,
  /l[oö]sch/i,
  /entfernen/i,
  /verwijder/i,
  /cancellare/i,
  /sopprimere/i,
  /삭제|해지|탈퇴|削除|消去|删除|刪除|注销/,
  /usuni[eę]/i,
  /usu[nń]/i,
  /удал/i,
  /حذف/,
  /sil(?:me|mek)/i,
  /hapus/i,
];

const NON_DELETION_ACTIONS = [
  [/(?:mobile )?number .* out of date|replace it with the new one/i, 'correction'],
  [/surname is misspelled|can you correct it/i, 'correction'],
  [/change the email address/i, 'correction'],
  [/reset(?:ting)? the login|can'?t access my profile/i, 'access_help'],
  [/stop the promotional emails|remove me from marketing lists/i, 'marketing_opt_out'],
  [
    /download my account information|send me a copy of the information|copy of last year'?s invoices|what personal information you hold/i,
    'access',
  ],
];

function classifyIntent(rawText) {
  const body = String(rawText || '').trim();
  const result = {
    is_deletion: false,
    label: 'unclear',
    matched_terms: [],
    matched_negations: [],
    non_deletion_action: '',
  };
  if (!body) return result;

  const negations = HARD_NEGATIONS.filter((re) => re.test(body)).map((re) => re.source);
  if (negations.length) {
    result.label = 'not_deletion';
    result.matched_negations = negations;
    return result;
  }

  const terms = DELETION_TERMS.filter((re) => re.test(body)).map((re) => re.source);
  const action = NON_DELETION_ACTIONS.find(([re]) => re.test(body));
  result.non_deletion_action = action ? action[1] : '';
  if (terms.length) {
    result.is_deletion = true;
    result.label = 'deletion';
    result.matched_terms = terms;
    return result;
  }
  if (action) {
    result.label = 'not_deletion';
    return result;
  }
  return result;
}

  const max = Math.max(actual.length, expected.length);
  const fields = ['phase', 'system_id', 'resource_id', 'operation', 'state', 'evidence_id'];

import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import dotenv from 'dotenv';
import { buildEvidenceStore } from './lib/evidence.js';
import { createIdentityResolver } from './lib/identity.js';
import { Linker } from './lib/linker.js';
import { inferResources } from './lib/inference.js';
import { buildCaseContexts } from './lib/context.js';
import { decideCase, serializeDecision } from './lib/engine.js';
import { classifyIntentWithGemini } from './lib/gemini.js';
import { usage } from './lib/usage.js';
import { loadRequests, loadSampleOutput } from './lib/tables.js';
import { ROOT_DIR, BUILD_DIR, PHASE_ORDER, OPERATION_STATE, STATE_PLAN } from './lib/config.js';
import { readCsv, writeCsv, parseTs } from './lib/util.js';

dotenv.config({ path: path.join(ROOT_DIR, 'code', '.env') });
dotenv.config({ path: path.join(ROOT_DIR, '.env') });

const OUTPUT_PATH = path.join(ROOT_DIR, 'output.csv');
const OUT_COLUMNS = ['case_id', 'deletion_status', 'steps_json'];
const ALLOWED_STATUS = new Set(['COMPLETE', 'INCOMPLETE', 'NOT_APPLICABLE']);
const ALLOWED_PHASES = new Set(['FINDING', 'REMEDIATION', 'VERIFICATION']);
const ALLOWED_OPS = new Set(Object.keys(OPERATION_STATE));
const STEP_FIELDS = ['step_no', 'phase', 'system_id', 'resource_id', 'operation', 'state', 'evidence_id'];

async function runPipeline({ sample = false, caseId = '', useAi = false } = {}) {
  usage.reset();
  const { store } = await buildEvidenceStore();
  const resolver = createIdentityResolver();
  const linker = new Linker(resolver, store);
  linker.run();

  const source = sample ? loadRequests(true) : loadRequests(false);
  const requests = caseId ? source.filter((row) => row.case_id === caseId) : source;
  if (caseId && !requests.length) throw new Error(`Unknown case: ${caseId}`);
  const caseUsers = new Map(requests.map((request) => [request.case_id, resolver.resolveCase(request).userId]));
  const inference = inferResources(store, caseUsers, requests);
  const contexts = buildCaseContexts({
    store,
    resourceUsers: inference.resourceUsers,
    requests,
    resolver,
  });
  const decisions = [];
  for (const context of contexts) {
    let decision = decideCase(context);
    if (useAi && decision.intent.label === 'unclear') {
      const fallback = await classifyIntentWithGemini(context.request_text, { caseId: context.case_id });
      if (fallback.ok) decision = decideCase(context, fallback.intent);
    }
    decisions.push(decision);
  }
  return { store, resolver, linker, inference, contexts, decisions };
}

function summaryOf(decisions) {
  const counts = { COMPLETE: 0, INCOMPLETE: 0, NOT_APPLICABLE: 0 };
  for (const decision of decisions) counts[decision.deletion_status] += 1;
  return counts;
}

function writeJson(filePath, value) {
  fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(filePath), { recursive: true });
  fs.writeFileSync(filePath, `${JSON.stringify(value, null, 2)}\n`, 'utf8');
}

function canonical(value) {
  if (Array.isArray(value)) return `[${value.map(canonical).join(',')}]`;
  if (value && typeof value === 'object') {
    return `{${Object.keys(value).sort().map((key) => `${JSON.stringify(key)}:${canonical(value[key])}`).join(',')}}`;
  }
  return JSON.stringify(value);
}

function parseSteps(text) {
  try {
    const parsed = JSON.parse(text);
    return Array.isArray(parsed) ? parsed : [];
  } catch {
    return [];
  }
}

function compareSteps(actual, expected) {
  const max = Math.max(actual.length, expected.length);
  const fields = ['phase', 'system_id', 'resource_id', 'operation', 'state', 'evidence_id'];
  const fieldCorrect = Object.fromEntries(fields.map((field) => [field, 0]));
  let positionCorrect = 0;
  for (let index = 0; index < max; index += 1) {
    const a = actual[index];
    const b = expected[index];
    if (!a || !b) continue;
    if (fields.every((field) => a[field] === b[field])) positionCorrect += 1;
    for (const field of fields) if (a[field] === b[field]) fieldCorrect[field] += 1;
  }
  const sequence = actual.length === expected.length
    && actual.every((step, index) => (
      step.phase === expected[index].phase
      && step.system_id === expected[index].system_id
      && step.resource_id === expected[index].resource_id
      && step.operation === expected[index].operation
    ));
  const exact = canonical(actual) === canonical(expected);
  return { exact, sequence, positionCorrect, fieldCorrect, denominator: max };
}

function scoreSample() {
  return runPipeline({ sample: true }).then(({ decisions }) => {
    const golden = loadSampleOutput();
    const rows = [];
    let statusCorrect = 0;
    let exact = 0;
    let sequenceCorrect = 0;
    let positionCorrect = 0;
    let positionTotal = 0;
    const fieldCorrect = { phase: 0, system_id: 0, resource_id: 0, operation: 0, state: 0, evidence_id: 0 };
    const failures = [];

    for (const decision of decisions) {
      const expectedRow = golden.get(decision.case_id);
      if (!expectedRow) continue;
      const expectedStatus = expectedRow.deletion_status;
      const expectedSteps = parseSteps(expectedRow.steps_json);
      const actualSteps = decision.steps;
      if (decision.deletion_status === expectedStatus) statusCorrect += 1;
      const cmp = compareSteps(actualSteps, expectedSteps);
      if (cmp.exact) exact += 1;
      if (cmp.sequence) sequenceCorrect += 1;
      positionCorrect += cmp.positionCorrect;
      positionTotal += cmp.denominator;
      for (const key of Object.keys(fieldCorrect)) fieldCorrect[key] += cmp.fieldCorrect[key];
      if (!cmp.exact) {
        failures.push({
          case_id: decision.case_id,
          status: decision.deletion_status,
          expected_status: expectedStatus,
          actual_count: actualSteps.length,
          expected_count: expectedSteps.length,
          actual: actualSteps,
          expected: expectedSteps,
        });
      }
      rows.push({ case_id: decision.case_id, status: decision.deletion_status, expected_status: expectedStatus, cmp });
    }

    const count = decisions.length;
    const report = {
      cases: count,
      status_accuracy: count ? statusCorrect / count : 0,
      status_correct: statusCorrect,
      exact_case_accuracy: count ? exact / count : 0,
      exact_cases: exact,
      sequence_accuracy: count ? sequenceCorrect / count : 0,
      sequence_cases: sequenceCorrect,
      step_position_accuracy: positionTotal ? positionCorrect / positionTotal : 0,
      step_positions_correct: positionCorrect,
      step_positions_total: positionTotal,
      field_accuracy: Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(fieldCorrect).map(([key, value]) => [key, positionTotal ? value / positionTotal : 0])),
      field_correct: fieldCorrect,
      failures,
      rows,
    };
    writeJson(path.join(BUILD_DIR, 'sample-score.json'), report);
    return report;
  });
}

function predict() {
  return runPipeline({ sample: false }).then(({ decisions, inference, contexts }) => {
    const rows = decisions
      .slice()
      .sort((a, b) => a.case_id.localeCompare(b.case_id))
      .map(serializeDecision);
    writeCsv(OUTPUT_PATH, rows, OUT_COLUMNS);
    writeJson(path.join(BUILD_DIR, 'predictions.json'), decisions.map((decision) => ({
      case_id: decision.case_id,
      deletion_status: decision.deletion_status,
      intent: decision.intent,
      resources: decision.resources,
      steps: decision.steps,
    })));
    writeJson(path.join(BUILD_DIR, 'assignments.json'), inference.assignments);
    writeJson(path.join(BUILD_DIR, 'case-contexts.json'), contexts);
    console.log(`Wrote ${rows.length} rows to ${OUTPUT_PATH}`);
    console.log('Status counts:', summaryOf(decisions));
    return { rows, decisions };
  });
}

function build() {
  return runPipeline({ sample: false }).then(({ store, contexts, decisions, inference }) => {
    const stats = store.stats();
    writeJson(path.join(BUILD_DIR, 'store-summary.json'), {
      stats,
      parse_log: store.parseLog,
      assignments: inference.assignments.length,
    });
    writeJson(path.join(BUILD_DIR, 'contexts.json'), contexts);
    writeJson(path.join(BUILD_DIR, 'decisions.json'), decisions);
    console.log(JSON.stringify({ stats, assignments: inference.assignments.length, status: summaryOf(decisions) }, null, 2));
    return { store, stats };
  });
}

function validateOutput() {
  const errors = [];
  const rows = readCsv(OUTPUT_PATH);
  const expected = loadRequests(false);
  if (rows.length !== expected.length) errors.push(`row count ${rows.length} != ${expected.length}`);
  if (rows.length && Object.keys(rows[0]).join(',') !== OUT_COLUMNS.join(',')) {
    errors.push(`columns ${Object.keys(rows[0]).join(',')} != ${OUT_COLUMNS.join(',')}`);
  }
  const expectedIds = expected.map((row) => row.case_id);
  const seen = new Set();
  for (let index = 0; index < rows.length; index += 1) {
    const row = rows[index];
    const caseId = row.case_id;
    if (seen.has(caseId)) errors.push(`duplicate case ${caseId}`);
    seen.add(caseId);
    if (expectedIds[index] !== caseId) errors.push(`row ${index + 1} case ${caseId} != ${expectedIds[index]}`);
    if (!ALLOWED_STATUS.has(row.deletion_status)) errors.push(`${caseId}: bad status ${row.deletion_status}`);
    let steps;
    try {
      steps = JSON.parse(row.steps_json);
    } catch {
      errors.push(`${caseId}: steps_json is not valid JSON`);
      continue;
    }
    if (!Array.isArray(steps)) {
      errors.push(`${caseId}: steps_json is not an array`);
      continue;
    }
    if (row.deletion_status === 'NOT_APPLICABLE' && (steps.length !== 0 || row.steps_json !== '[]')) {
      errors.push(`${caseId}: NOT_APPLICABLE must have []`);
    }
    let phase = -1;
    for (let stepIndex = 0; stepIndex < steps.length; stepIndex += 1) {
      const step = steps[stepIndex];
      const keys = Object.keys(step).sort().join(',');
      if (keys !== STEP_FIELDS.slice().sort().join(',')) errors.push(`${caseId} step ${stepIndex + 1}: bad fields ${keys}`);
      if (step.step_no !== stepIndex + 1) errors.push(`${caseId} step ${stepIndex + 1}: step_no ${step.step_no}`);
      if (!ALLOWED_PHASES.has(step.phase)) errors.push(`${caseId} step ${stepIndex + 1}: bad phase ${step.phase}`);
      if (!ALLOWED_OPS.has(step.operation)) errors.push(`${caseId} step ${stepIndex + 1}: bad operation ${step.operation}`);
      if (OPERATION_STATE[step.operation] !== step.state) errors.push(`${caseId} step ${stepIndex + 1}: bad state ${step.state} for ${step.operation}`);
      if (!step.system_id || !step.resource_id) errors.push(`${caseId} step ${stepIndex + 1}: missing system/resource`);
      if (step.phase === 'FINDING' && step.evidence_id === '') errors.push(`${caseId} step ${stepIndex + 1}: finding needs evidence`);
      if (step.phase === 'REMEDIATION' && step.evidence_id !== '') errors.push(`${caseId} step ${stepIndex + 1}: remediation must have empty evidence`);
      if (step.phase === 'VERIFICATION') {
        if (row.deletion_status === 'COMPLETE' && step.evidence_id === '') {
          errors.push(`${caseId} step ${stepIndex + 1}: complete verification needs evidence`);
        }
        if (row.deletion_status === 'INCOMPLETE' && step.evidence_id !== '') {
          errors.push(`${caseId} step ${stepIndex + 1}: future verification must have empty evidence`);
        }
      }
      const order = PHASE_ORDER[step.phase];
      if (order < phase) errors.push(`${caseId} step ${stepIndex + 1}: phase order`);
      phase = Math.max(phase, order);
    }
  }

async function main() {
  const command = process.argv[2] || 'predict';
  const caseArgIndex = process.argv.indexOf('--case');
  const caseId = caseArgIndex >= 0 ? process.argv[caseArgIndex + 1] : '';
  if (command === 'build') await build();
  else if (command === 'predict') await predict();

# HackerRank Orchestrate - October 2026

## Ghost Data Still Exists

Build an AI agent that audits whether a user's personal data was actually deleted.

A deletion workflow may report **Complete** while data still exists in databases, logs, support attachments, exports, search indexes, archives, or backups. Sync and restore processes may also bring deleted data back.

For each request, the agent must first determine whether deletion was actually requested. It then returns `COMPLETE`, `INCOMPLETE`, or `NOT_APPLICABLE`, reports any remaining data or recreation risk, and produces the ordered remediation and verification steps required to finish an authorized deletion safely.

Read [`problem_statement.md`](./problem_statement.md) for the complete challenge contract.

---

## Quick Start

Clone the repository and move into the project directory:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/interviewstreet/hackerrank-orchestrate-october26.git
cd hackerrank-orchestrate-october26
```

Start your AI coding tool from the **repository root** so it automatically reads [`AGENTS.md`](./AGENTS.md) and logs your session turns to `log.txt` in the root directory.

Build your solution in `code/main.py`, or use another language and document its setup and run command clearly in your README.

Your solution must:

- Read the input files from `dataset/`
- Generate one prediction row for every request in `dataset/deletion_requests.csv`
- Write the final predictions to `output.csv` in the repository root

Run the starter Python entry point with:

```bash
python3 code/main.py
```

The blank template at `dataset/output.csv` is provided as a reference. Your final generated file for submission must be the root-level `output.csv`.


## Dataset

All participant-facing files are in `dataset/`:

| File | Contents |
| --- | --- |
| `deletion_requests.csv` | 518 requests |
| `sample_deletion_requests.csv` | 32 sample requests |
| `sample_output.csv` | Correct sample answers |
| `user_identities.csv` | Current user identities |
| `user_audit_log.csv` | Historical identity changes |
| `system_activity.csv` | Activity across services and data processes |
| `deletion_rules.csv` | Required treatment for each data category |
| `evidence_files.csv` | Manifest of supplied evidence files |
| `output.csv` | Blank output template |

Evidence is stored under `dataset/evidence/` and may include PDFs, images, logs, JSON, plain text, or SQL snapshot exports. SQL captures may contain a primary database, regional replicas, a reporting replica, or a failover replica so replication drift can be investigated directly. The `.sql` files are readable as text and executable with SQLite.

Only `deletion_requests.csv` requires answers. The other files provide evidence and context.

---

## Output

Create `output.csv` with these columns in this exact order:

```text
case_id,deletion_status,steps_json
```

Produce exactly one row per request. `deletion_status` is `COMPLETE`, `INCOMPLETE`, or `NOT_APPLICABLE`. `steps_json` is an ordered JSON array containing findings, remediation actions, and verification checks. Use an empty array (`[]`) for `NOT_APPLICABLE`. Evidence references may be a `file_id`, `activity_id`, or `audit_id`. Determine the resource state at `audit_at` from the available evidence; reported workflow statuses and operation results are claims. Use `dataset/sample_output.csv` as the format reference.

The final file must contain 518 data rows sorted by `case_id` (plus the header row). The grader parses `steps_json` as JSON, so object-key order and whitespace do not matter; array order does. Order findings, remediation, and verification in that phase order. Within a phase, follow the operation order in the problem statement, then sort by `system_id` and `resource_id`.

---

## Evaluation

`output.csv` will be compared with hidden canonical answers. Scoring considers:

- deletion assessment accuracy;
- current and historical identity resolution;
- discovery of remaining data and recreation risks;
- correct policy application and evidence references; and
- completeness and ordering of remediation and verification steps.

Your `code.zip` must include:

```text
code/evaluation/evaluation_report.md
code/evaluation/usage_report.md
```

- `evaluation_report.md` must cover case, row, field, and sequence accuracy, at least three additional evaluation cases created by you, failures found, and improvements made.
- `usage_report.md` must cover the final full-dataset run, including model providers and names, model calls, input and output tokens, total and average tokens per request, and estimated total and per-request cost. Include per-model and overall totals when using multiple models.

**Important:** Place `evaluation_report.md` and `usage_report.md` inside `code/evaluation/` (matching `code/evaluation/main.py` in this starter layout), write your complete evaluation metrics, custom evaluation test cases, and token/cost breakdowns directly inside those Markdown files, and keep prompts in source code or Markdown files. Automated code evaluation ignores raw data files (`.csv`, `.tsv`, `.json`, `.jsonl`, `.sql`, `.log`), so content stored only in those formats will not be visible to the code judge or AI interviewer.

---

import { PHASE_ORDER, OPERATION_ORDER, OPERATION_STATE, STATE_PLAN } from './config.js';

function planFor(category, state) {
  const table = STATE_PLAN[category];
  if (!table) return [null, null, null];
  return table[state] || [null, null, null];
}

function isCompliant(category, state) {
  if (category === 'SECURITY_AUDIT_LOG' || category === 'LEGAL_HOLD_RECORD') {
    return ['PRESENT', 'RETAINED'].includes(state);
  }
  return ['ABSENT', 'REDACTED', 'ANONYMIZED', 'DISABLED', 'BLOCKED', 'RETAINED'].includes(state);
}

function stateForOperation(operation) {
  return OPERATION_STATE[operation] || 'PRESENT';
}

function buildSteps(resources, status) {
  if (status === 'NOT_APPLICABLE') return [];
  const planned = [];
  for (const resource of resources) {
    const category = resource.category || 'UNKNOWN';
    const state = resource.state || 'PRESENT';
    if (status === 'COMPLETE' && resource.evidence_kind !== 'manifest') continue;
    let [finding, remediation, verification] = planFor(category, state);
    if (!verification) continue;

    const base = { system_id: resource.system, resource_id: resource.resource_id };
    const findingState = finding === 'REPORT_ACTIVE_DATA_FLOW' || finding === 'REPORT_RESTORE_RISK'
      ? 'ACTIVE'
      : 'PRESENT';
    const findingEvidence = status === 'COMPLETE' ? '' : (resource.evidence_id || '');
    if (finding) {
      planned.push({
        ...base,
        phase: 'FINDING',
        operation: finding,
        state: findingState,
        evidence_id: findingEvidence,
      });
    }
    if (remediation) {
      planned.push({
        ...base,
        phase: 'REMEDIATION',
        operation: remediation,
        state: stateForOperation(remediation),
        evidence_id: '',
      });
    }
    const verificationEvidence = status === 'COMPLETE' && resource.evidence_kind === 'manifest'
      ? (resource.evidence_id || '')
      : '';
    planned.push({
      ...base,
      phase: 'VERIFICATION',
      operation: verification,
      state: stateForOperation(verification),
      evidence_id: verificationEvidence,
    });
  }

  planned.sort((a, b) => (
    (PHASE_ORDER[a.phase] ?? 9) - (PHASE_ORDER[b.phase] ?? 9)
    || (OPERATION_ORDER[a.operation] ?? 99) - (OPERATION_ORDER[b.operation] ?? 99)
    || a.system_id.localeCompare(b.system_id)
    || a.resource_id.localeCompare(b.resource_id)
  ));
  return planned.map((step, index) => ({
    step_no: index + 1,
    phase: step.phase,
    system_id: step.system_id,
    resource_id: step.resource_id,
    operation: step.operation,
    state: step.state,
    evidence_id: step.evidence_id,
  }));
}

function buildPlanView(resource) {
  return {
    system: resource.system,
    resource_id: resource.resource_id,
    category: resource.category,
    state: resource.state,
    evidence_id: resource.evidence_kind === 'manifest' ? (resource.evidence_id || '') : '',
  };
}

export { buildSteps, isCompliant, planFor, buildPlanView };

function classifyIntent(rawText) {
  const body = String(rawText || '').trim();
  const result = {
    is_deletion: false,
    label: 'unclear',
    matched_terms: [],
    matched_negations: [],
    non_deletion_action: '',
  };
  if (!body) return result;

  const negations = HARD_NEGATIONS.filter((re) => re.test(body)).map((re) => re.source);
  if (negations.length) {
    result.label = 'not_deletion';
    result.matched_negations = negations;
    return result;
  }

  const terms = DELETION_TERMS.filter((re) => re.test(body)).map((re) => re.source);
  const action = NON_DELETION_ACTIONS.find(([re]) => re.test(body));
  result.non_deletion_action = action ? action[1] : '';
  if (terms.length) {
    result.is_deletion = true;
    result.label = 'deletion';
    result.matched_terms = terms;
    return result;
  }
  if (action) {
    result.label = 'not_deletion';
    return result;
  }
  return result;
}

  /not asking for deletion/i,
  /not a request to erase/i,
  /not a request to delete/i,
  /do not close the account/i,
  /don'?t close the account/i,

  /i still (?:need|use|want) the account/i,
  /i want to continue using the service/i,
  /i still want receipts/i,
  /this is an information request/i,
];

const DELETION_TERMS = [
  /delet/i,
  /eras/i,
  /erasure/i,
  /remov/i,
  /\bgone\b/i,
  /close (?:my|this|the) account/i,
  /clos(?:e|ed|ing) (?:it|my|this|the) account/i,
  /\bclosed\b/i,
  /purge/i,
  /permanently removed?/i,
  /profile is gone/i,
  /nothing .* point back to me/i,
  /elimina/i,
  /eliminaci[oó]n/i,
  /borrar/i,
  /borrado/i,
  /exclus[ãa]o/i,
  /excluir/i,
  /apagar/i,
  /deletar/i,
  /suprimir/i,
  /cerrar (?:mi|la) cuenta/i,
  /suppress?ion/i,
  /supprimer/i,
  /effacer/i,
  /l[oö]sch/i,
  /entfernen/i,
  /verwijder/i,
  /cancellare/i,
  /sopprimere/i,
  /삭제|해지|탈퇴|削除|消去|删除|刪除|注销/,
  /usuni[eę]/i,
  /usu[nń]/i,
  /удал/i,
  /حذف/,
  /sil(?:me|mek)/i,
  /hapus/i,
];

const NON_DELETION_ACTIONS = [
  [/(?:mobile )?number .* out of date|replace it with the new one/i, 'correction'],
  [/surname is misspelled|can you correct it/i, 'correction'],
  [/change the email address/i, 'correction'],
  [/reset(?:ting)? the login|can'?t access my profile/i, 'access_help'],
  [/stop the promotional emails|remove me from marketing lists/i, 'marketing_opt_out'],
  [
    /download my account information|send me a copy of the information|copy of last year'?s invoices|what personal information you hold/i,
    'access',
  ],
];

function classifyIntent(rawText) {
  const body = String(rawText || '').trim();
  const result = {
    is_deletion: false,
    label: 'unclear',
    matched_terms: [],
    matched_negations: [],
    non_deletion_action: '',
  };
  if (!body) return result;

  const negations = HARD_NEGATIONS.filter((re) => re.test(body)).map((re) => re.source);
  if (negations.length) {
    result.label = 'not_deletion';
    result.matched_negations = negations;
    return result;
  }

  const terms = DELETION_TERMS.filter((re) => re.test(body)).map((re) => re.source);
  const action = NON_DELETION_ACTIONS.find(([re]) => re.test(body));
  result.non_deletion_action = action ? action[1] : '';
  if (terms.length) {
    result.is_deletion = true;
    result.label = 'deletion';
    result.matched_terms = terms;
    return result;
  }
  if (action) {
    result.label = 'not_deletion';
    return result;
  }
  return result;
}

export { classifyIntent };

import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';
import { z } from 'zod';
import { usage } from './usage.js';

const __dirname = path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url));
const PROMPT_PATH = path.join(__dirname, '..', 'prompts', 'intent_guard.txt');
const MODEL = process.env.GEMINI_MODEL || 'gemini-3.5-flash-lite';
const ENDPOINT = 'https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models';
const TIMEOUT_MS = 30000;

const IntentSchema = z.object({
  is_deletion: z.boolean(),
  label: z.enum(['deletion', 'not_deletion', 'unclear']),
  confidence: z.number().min(0).max(1),
  action: z.enum(['delete', 'access', 'correction', 'export', 'marketing_opt_out', 'other']),
  reason: z.string().max(400),
});

const RESPONSE_SCHEMA = {
  type: 'object',
  properties: {
    is_deletion: { type: 'boolean' },
    label: { type: 'string', enum: ['deletion', 'not_deletion', 'unclear'] },
    confidence: { type: 'number', minimum: 0, maximum: 1 },
    action: {
      type: 'string',
      enum: ['delete', 'access', 'correction', 'export', 'marketing_opt_out', 'other'],
    },
    reason: { type: 'string', maxLength: 400 },
  },
  required: ['is_deletion', 'label', 'confidence', 'action', 'reason'],
};

function prompt() {
  try {
    return fs.readFileSync(PROMPT_PATH, 'utf8').trim();
  } catch {
    return 'Decide whether the customer message authorizes deletion. Return only the requested JSON object.';
  }
}

function candidateText(payload) {
  const parts = payload?.candidates?.[0]?.content?.parts;
  if (!Array.isArray(parts)) return '';
  return parts.map((part) => (typeof part?.text === 'string' ? part.text : '')).join('').trim();
}

async function classifyIntentWithGemini(requestText, { caseId = '' } = {}) {
  const apiKey = process.env.GEMINI_API_KEY;
  if (!apiKey) return { ok: false, error: 'GEMINI_API_KEY is not set' };

    systemInstruction: { parts: [{ text: prompt() }] },
    contents: [{
      role: 'user',
      parts: [{ text: `Customer message:\n${String(requestText || '').slice(0, 4000)}` }],
    }],
    generationConfig: {
      temperature: 0,
      maxOutputTokens: 300,
      responseMimeType: 'application/json',
